name: robots/xarm-developer__xarm-python-sdk
title: UFACTORY xArm 7 (xarm.XArmAPI)
intro: UFACTORY xArm 7 (xarm.XArmAPI), adapted from xarm-developer/xarm-python-sdk. It reads `joint_positions`, `tcp_pose`, `state`, `mode` and 2 more; runs `move_joints`, `move_pose`, `jog_joints` and `enable_motion`. `move_joints`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
